capabilities: render a spinning wheel from a wp codeblock
pick a random item by clicking the spin button
customize wheel colors, size, and animation length
define wheel slices as one line per item
disambiguation: Not a random note opener; it picks random items from lists you write in a codeblock, not random files from the vault.
extras: Wheels need at least two rows of data to display; the author accepts tips via a personal website and asks for bug reports by email at EZRA-DVLPR@protonmail.com.
motivation: The author wanted to help users visualize and select from a list in a fun way.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to visualize a list of options and pick one at random inside a note.
summary: Codeblock-based plugin that renders a colorful spinning wheel which randomly selects one item from the list it is given.
